summary: BOS Better Online Solutions Ltd, an Israeli foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K containing its interim financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026, including segment and geographic revenue breakouts and goodwill, intangibles and lease disclosures. No transaction, shareholder vote, board recommendation or advisor is referenced. This is a routine semi-annual reporting filing, the US equivalent of a domestic quarterly report on Form 10-Q, not a special situation. There are no deal terms, no overhang mechanics and no risk-arb angle to monitor.
